WITH status_data AS (
  SELECT 
    si.healtheval,
    s.scancount,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin != 0 
      THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin 
      ELSE NULL 
    END as ratio
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' 
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
status_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) as total_scans,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM status_data
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean
  FROM status_summary
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ss.healtheval,
  ss.total_scans,
  ss.avg_ratio,
  ss.avg_ratio - os.overall_mean as deviation
FROM status_summary ss
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE os.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.healtheval
